name: Home-stand first leg parlay (2-leg, cross-game)
rule: Frozen before the first bet. Any change to signal, threshold, universe or settlement is a NEW strategy with a NEW id and a new hash; the old record is never edited, so a reader can always tell whether the rule moved.
settlement_rule: parlay wins if BOTH legs win. Priced with the measured cross-game correlation (assumed 0 across different games — a disclosed assumption, not a measurement) and printed beside the naive product.
signal: two independent games where each pick clears P ≥ 0.60 under estimator A
thesis: Cross-game legs are close to independent; the naive product is therefore close to right, and the print-both rule shows by how much.
threshold: both legs p ≥ 0.60; legs from different games
universe: pairs of games on the same date
